name: Mother Effigy
descriptionTemplate: At the end of each turn, when playing the first Command Card with the corresponding Awakener, gain 20 Aliemus. When you have the Relic {Devoted Heart}, grant other Awakeners 5 Aliemus.
lore: "I'll give you anything, whatever you want, please let him go."
